headline: TransDigm (TDG) Adds Another Bolt-On: What the $1.07 Billion Prince & Izant Deal Says About Its Playbook
summary: Although chronic supply chain bottlenecks continue to dampen new commercial aircraft deliveries, the main driving force of the aerospace sector this year is the aging of the global airline fleet. With average airframe ages crossing 15 years, airlines are increasingly reliant on intensive maintenance, repair, and overhaul cycles to maintain operability.
